title: Hanging From the Head-Line, One Piece at a Time
label: ch:bn-script-first
canDo: I can write nine Bengali pieces from memory — six consonants, a vowel sign, its independent twin and the hasanta — and read the greeting I have been saying since the first chapter by assembling it from those pieces, including its conjunct.

payoff.summary: The greeting assembled from seven pieces the reader can each write from memory, including the conjunct and the letter written s but said sh, and introducing nothing new.
